info.title: Entra Sign-In Reports BFF - start sign-in
info.description: IF-1, provided by ST-1 (CMP-2). Starts the OIDC authorization code flow with PKCE, state and nonce against Keycloak (realm signin-reports, kc_idp_hint to Microsoft). ST-17 uses maxAge=0 to force re-authentication before an approval (AD-5: approve requires auth_time within 900 s).

get.summary: Redirect the browser to Keycloak to sign in

parameters.name: returnTo
parameters.description: Same-origin path to return to after sign-in, for example /approvals?resume=<proposalId>. Absolute or cross-origin values are refused.

parameters.name: maxAge
parameters.description: OIDC max_age in seconds. 0 forces a fresh Microsoft sign-in (used before approving).

302.description: Redirect to the Keycloak authorization endpoint. Sets the 5-minute SameSite=Lax login-transaction cookie.

Location.description: Keycloak /realms/signin-reports/protocol/openid-connect/auth URL with code_challenge, state, nonce and optional max_age.

Set-Cookie.description: __Host-sr_login transaction cookie: httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, Max-Age=300.
